situation (example wording): "How did aggravated assaults with a firearm change in Texas from 2018 to 2024?" (a detail only NIBRS records, over years when many agencies joined NIBRS)
what the app does today: Counts every agency that reported in each year, so agencies joining looks like crime rising. Consistent reporters only when the user asks.
proposed behavior: Count every agency that reported in each year (keep today's default), with a prominently displayed note that the trend can be shown for consistently reporting agencies only, offered as a button. For a single national or state total of such a detail, say what share of the population the reporting agencies cover.
exact default or choices offered: Default: all reporting agencies. The participation change is disclosed by the lead's Consistent Reporting Agencies offer (P80, P85), not a sentence in the notes; the button (or the lead's link) opens the consistent view.
why: The full count is what was reported; the offer makes clear that participation changed and opens the consistent view.
status: Decided 2026-10-28 (Jeff: show everything, with a prominent note offering consistent reporters); amended 2026-11-01 (Jeff's notes rule, P85: the lead's offer replaces the note)
test cases: No test found: no test cites this row or asks its example question.
